scope: Read-only production-data audit and independent time-ordered numerical validation

independent_check_thresholds.on_exceedance: Retain a warning and set numerical_validation_passed=false; never modify production data

interpretation: Unitarity alone does not establish time-discretization accuracy. Coarse M32/64/128 results are diagnostics; only the adaptive production data are plotted. The phase-reversal partners outside 0..pi are new independent propagations, never filled into the requested grid. Small finite-L IPR/Dn changes alone do not establish a thermodynamic localization transition. Near degeneracies can make individual eigenstate observables sensitive to basis choice; fixed reflection sectors and explicit mode matching are retained.
